title: Love, Marriage, Sex, and Dishes: Setting Boundaries in Romantic Relationships
coreMove: Romantic boundaries work when partners define shared systems for labor and conflict, then protect privacy, consent, and bodily autonomy with limits they can actually hold.

exampleSpecs.audience: Jerome, a partner turning resentment into a task standard
exampleSpecs.stakes: A recurring chore fight may become a character attack instead of a workable agreement.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show dishes moving from vague help to full ownership with a minimum standard.

exampleSpecs.audience: Mila, a partner replacing scorekeeping with task ownership
exampleSpecs.stakes: Invisible work may keep gathering on the person who notices first.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Fair Play as a shared operating system for household labor.

exampleSpecs.domain: breakfast cleanup after a failed agreement
exampleSpecs.audience: Ivy, a partner repairing a chore agreement after it broke
exampleSpecs.stakes: The first failed attempt can either refine the agreement or restart the resentment loop.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show a chore agreement being repaired through the minimum standard rather than blame.

exampleSpecs.audience: Holly, a partner protecting private space inside intimacy
exampleSpecs.stakes: A repeated privacy breach may be treated as harmless unless the limit becomes enforceable.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Move from verbal privacy request to locked-door enforcement.

exampleSpecs.audience: Georges, a partner checking whether consent is real
exampleSpecs.stakes: Pressure can dress itself as romance and make a reluctant yes look cooperative.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Separate a true yes from pressure, obligation, or fear of disappointing a partner.

exampleSpecs.domain: dinner conversation after a bank fee
exampleSpecs.audience: Janelle, a partner keeping one issue in the room
exampleSpecs.stakes: An argument may become unsolvable if old grievances crowd out the current need.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep conflict on one subject instead of piling on old complaints.
